newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AptarGroup estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AptarGroup estimate raised.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Monday it raised its estimate for AptarGroup Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $2.39 from $2.30 in light of the company's stronger-than-expected results in the fourth quarter of 1996.
-- AptarGroup reported earnings of $0.50 a share for the period ended December 31, significantly higher than Mesirow's estimate of $0.43, Mesirow said.
-- Mesirow said a rebound in specialized pump sales to fragrance and cosmetics companies fueled growth in the period, and that trend is expected to continue in 1997.
-- AptarGroup makes pumps for several industries.
-- Its shares closed up 1/8 Monday at 38-1/2.
